overview_description.description: Breathe Wellbeing is a health tech startup that helps people manage and prevent type 2 diabetes. It also helps people move towards a healthy life and reduce their risk of chronic diseases. Their clinically proven program has helped 10,000+ members to lose weight, reduce blood sugar and prevent health complications. With individual lifestyle tracking and personalized counseling, combined with social interactions via healthy competitions, Breathe will partner in building long-term healthy habits.

about_short_description.short_description: Breathe Wellbeing is a health tech startup that helps people manage and prevent type 2 diabetes.

product.name: Diabetes Reversal Program
product.description: A clinically tested program designed to help individuals with type 2 diabetes and prediabetes manage and reverse their condition through personalized coaching, nutrition, fitness, and medical support.

product.name: Diabetes Diet Plan
product.description: A personalized Indian diet plan tailored for diabetic patients to help control blood sugar levels and support diabetes reversal through balanced nutrition and portion control.

product.name: Weight Loss Program
product.description: A program designed to assist individuals in losing weight through tailored diet and fitness plans, supporting overall health and diabetes management.

product.name: Diabetes Risk Assessment
product.description: An assessment tool to evaluate an individual's risk of developing type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, facilitating early intervention and management.

product.name: Mobile App for Diabetes Management
product.description: A mobile application that supports diabetes management by tracking health data, providing educational content, and facilitating communication with health coaches and medical experts.
